name: Stevns Klint
description: Stevns Klint is a stretch of white chalk cliffs on Denmark's island of Zealand, rising up to 40 metres above the Baltic coast. Within the rock, a thin dark layer of clay marks the moment about 65 million years ago when the Chicxulub meteorite struck Mexico and wiped out much of life on Earth. Fossils in the layers above chart how living things slowly recovered.
